moved: 9, the island: your outline, carried down toward the tee rock with the old triangle's top kept. The bold target sits there, 287 yd out, and leaves 223 yd: a 3 wood finished 10 yd from the pin. So the longer carry still pays.

9, the right fairway: your outline. It swells right over its upper half (about 43 m right of the line at its widest) and runs on to within about 14 m of the land's end; its left edge goes in and out. The grass under it is widened to match, and the land's far end runs on 7 m. Its fairway now ends 317 yd from the Marlin tee and leaves 281 yd (a 3 wood finished 34 yd short), so taking it is still three shots.
The cay between the 9th and the 8th (the 9th's old tee) is gone.
No other hole moved. Every Must passes at both tides; relief, alike (0 of 15) and spread pass. 3,315 yd.
